name: ccd-usage-monitor
description: Feeds the Claude Code desktop app's quota and context figures to ccd-usage-monitor, which the desktop app never runs as a status line, and pins the pill's line under the prompt.

exe.title: ccd-usage-monitor executable
exe.description: Full path to ccd-usage-monitor.exe. Empty takes the executable from the statusLine command, when that command ends in --bridge.

showLine.title: Show the line under the prompt
showLine.description: Pin the pill's line under the prompt. Off keeps feeding --bridge and draws nothing.
